section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Self-Compassion Scale (SCS), a 26-item self-report instrument that evaluates self-compassion through positive components (self-kindness, common humanity, mindfulness) and negative components (self-judgment, isolation, over-identification). The scale uses a 5-point rating system and has demonstrated good internal reliability (Cronbach's alpha = 0.92 for original version, 0.89 for Portuguese version). For this study, only the three positive subscales were combined into a composite self-compassion measure (SCS_SC) with a Cronbach's alpha of 0.91.
